note: Airport list = IATA codes that appear as a QTR origin or destination in the 365-day adsb.lol globe_history aggregates (h2h.json). Geometry is terminal-area clips from 6 sampled UTC day(s) of globe_history traces. Ground-roll samples are not Kalman-smoothed. Each clip is assigned to one OurAirports runway end by heading and lateral offset (parallel runways are not mixed). Representative paths are the medoid of the dominant cluster, anchored at an observed on-runway ADS-B sample — not snapped to the published threshold and not published SID/STAR. Gaps: dumps with no file, thin receiver coverage, and tracks that could not be assigned a runway are omitted rather than invented.
